title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: order of the grounds for rejecting a notice at registration
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line decides whether a registered notice is rejected at once, and with which controlled reason, on the grounds that turn only on the cover, the notice itself and the reefer service of the container named.

## Rule

1. The grounds are examined in the order below. The first ground that applies is the reason recorded, and a notice meeting none of them is not rejected under this rule.
   1. The amount on the notice is below the product's smallest claimed amount: below minimum claim.
   2. The product does not pay the kind of loss, or the reefer service rank is too low for temperature damage: not covered by tier.
   3. The notice is dated after the time bar: claim time-barred.
   4. The notice is dated after the last day of its notice window: notice out of time.
2. A notice that meets one of these grounds is rejected as soon as it is registered, because no claim document can remove the ground.
3. These grounds are examined before any rejection for no logged excursion, misdeclared cargo, an excluded peril or missing documents.

## Hypothetical priority cases

| Grounds met by the notice | Reason recorded |
|---|---|
| Below the smallest claimed amount and time-barred | Below minimum claim |
| Not covered by tier and out of time | Not covered by tier |
| Time-barred and out of time | Claim time-barred |
| Out of time only | Notice out of time |
| None of the four | Not rejected under this rule |

## Boundary case for the first ground

With a hypothetical smallest claimed amount of 120.00 USD: a notice amount of 119.99 USD is below it and the first ground applies; a notice amount of exactly 120.00 USD is not below it.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* wait for the claim documents before rejecting a time-barred notice. *Correct basis:* no document can remove the ground, so the notice is rejected as soon as it is registered.
